meta.name: web3-testing
meta.description: Test smart contracts comprehensively using Hardhat and Foundry with unit tests, integration tests, and mainnet forking. Use when testing Solidity contracts, setting up blockchain test suites, or validating DeFi protocols.

copy.tagline: 用主网分叉全面测试智能合约
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在发布去中心化金融协议前需要全面检查合约行为
copy.tagline_en: Test smart contracts thoroughly with mainnet forking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build DeFi protocols and need automated contract tests before launch.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会产出针对智能合约的测试代码:Hardhat/Foundry 配置、单元/集成测试、gas 测试、模糊测试、快照回滚、主网分叉、账户模拟等示例。
howto.when: 当用户要求测试 Solidity 合约、搭建区块链测试套件或验证 DeFi 协议时。

say.text: 帮我的 ERC20 代币写一组 Hardhat 单元测试。
say.note: 会输出测试文件与断言示例。

say.text: 用 Foundry 对转账函数做模糊测试,找出异常输入。
say.note: 生成带 fuzz 参数的 Solidity 测试。

say.text: 将主网 Uniswap 分叉到本地,跑一个集成测试。
say.note: 代码会包含主网 RPC 与合约调用。

howto.what_en: When active, Claude supplies concrete smart-contract testing code: Hardhat/Foundry configurations, unit and integration test examples, gas checks, fuzzing, snapshots/reverts, mainnet-fork tests, and account impersonation snippets.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to test Solidity contracts, set up blockchain test suites, or validate DeFi protocols.

say_en.text: Help me write Hardhat unit tests for my ERC20 token.
say_en.note: Produces a test file and assertions.

say_en.text: Fuzz the transfer function with Foundry to find bad inputs.
Fork Ethereum mainnet locally and run an integration test against Uniswap.
